events.context: Asks '怎样用brew install安装缺失的字体' about installing missing fonts with Homebrew
Provides Homebrew font installation guide: tap homebrew/cask-fonts, brew search font-, brew install --cask font-fira-code, examples for programming and Chinese fonts
Executes 'brew install stheiti' which fails: Warning: No available formula 'stheiti', Error: No formulae or casks found
Executes 'brew tap homebrew/cask-fonts' which fails: Error: homebrew/cask-fonts was deprecated
Updates font installation method for new Homebrew structure, explains STHeiti is macOS built-in, suggests alternatives like font-noto-sans-cjk
Executes 'ls /System/Library/Fonts/*.ttc | grep -i "heit"' confirming STHeiti Light.ttc and STHeiti Medium.ttc exist
Asks '那为什么latex编译通不过呢' why LaTeX compilation fails despite fonts existing
Diagnoses LaTeX font mapping issue, provides XeLaTeX solutions: setCJKmainfont{STHeiti Light}, alternatives like PingFang SC, font cache commands
Reports LaTeX Error: Command '\eth' already defined in amsfonts.sty line 240
Resolves \eth command conflict: add \let\eth\relax before package loading, provides complete working LaTeX example with fontspec, xeCJK, and amsfonts
